dict.string: Manage applications with Force Quit, Restart, Show in Finder options

#!/usr/bin/env python3 import subprocess import sys import time import os
def execute_action(action_data): """Execute the selected action.""" try: parts = action_data.split("|") action = parts[0]
if action == "quick_restart": app_name = parts[1] app_path = parts[2]
# First, try to quit gracefully subprocess.run(['osascript', '-e', f'tell application "{app_name}" to quit'], capture_output=True) time.sleep(0.5)
# Force kill if still running subprocess.run(['killall', app_name], capture_output=True) time.sleep(0.5)
# Launch the app subprocess.run(['open', app_path]) return f"Restarted {app_name}"
elif action == "force_quit": app_name = parts[1] subprocess.run(['killall', '-9', app_name]) return f"Force quit {app_name}"
elif action == "quit": app_name = parts[1] subprocess.run(['osascript', '-e', f'tell application "{app_name}" to quit']) return f"Quit {app_name}"
elif action == "launch": app_path = parts[2] subprocess.run(['open', app_path]) return f"Launched {parts[1]}"
elif action == "show_in_finder": app_path = parts[1] subprocess.run(['open', '-R', app_path]) return f"Revealed in Finder"
elif action == "get_info": app_path = parts[1] subprocess.run(['open', '--reveal', app_path]) subprocess.run(['osascript', '-e', f'tell application "Finder" to open information window of (POSIX file "{app_path}" as alias)']) return f"Opened info window"
else: return f"Unknown action: {action}"
except Exception as e: return f"Error: {str(e)}"
if __name__ == "__main__": query = sys.argv[1] if len(sys.argv) > 1 else "" result = execute_action(query) print(result)
